caption: The drawing depicts two distinct metal hardware objects set against a plain, light beige background. On the left, there is a horizontally-oriented latch consisting of a straight bar with a rounded end, a rectangular base, and a curved hook attached underneath; a small perpendicular piece projects upward from the middle of the bar. The latch is rendered in a dark, nearly black color, with minimal detail to suggest a matte, solid appearance. On the right, there is a vertical door handle composed of a slightly curved, elongated piece, anchored at both ends by large, teardrop-shaped plates. Each plate has three visible rivets or screws, with the upper part noticeably wider than the handle itself. The entire handle, like the latch, is colored in a similar dark, near-black shade, and both objects are centrally positioned with ample negative space surrounding them. The composition is balanced horizontally, with the objects aligned roughly on the same vertical axis. There is a faint signature, "Edward S. Hosmer," visible toward the left below the latch.
title: Shaker Door Latch
